## Context / Problem
Five modules derive "where is `.rebar` / the sidecar directory for this store" independently: `src/rebar/_store/hlc.py:80` (resolves symlinks), `src/rebar/_commands/compact_trigger.py:65` (resolves after bug `intangible-ladyish-vicuna`), `src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py:57` (resolves after `13f78e3165`), `src/rebar/_commands/doctor_locks.py:104`, `src/rebar/llm/overlap/queue.py:257`; `src/rebar/_store/push_state.py:89-116` parses `.git` by hand for the git dir and `src/rebar/_store/sync.py:281-301` re-derives the git common dir for quarantine. Three of these had the unresolved-symlink bug in turn (`nuclear-calm-heron`, `intangible-ladyish-vicuna`, `conscious-weighable-spittlebug`), each fixed one site per ticket.

## Approach
Add `src/rebar/_store/paths.py` with one frozen `StorePaths(tracker)` exposing `canonical` (realpath), `git_dir`, `git_common_dir`, `rebar_dir`, `sidecar(name)`, `log(name)`; every derivation above becomes a call. The class is the only place `os.path.realpath` is applied to a tracker path for sidecar purposes, so an unresolved derivation cannot be re-copied. A guard test asserts no module outside `paths.py` computes `dirname(tracker)`/`.rebar` joins for sidecars (token scan on `"/.rebar"` joins plus `_rebar_dir` definitions, owner excluded, `# store-path-ok:` marker escape).


## Guard construction
Follow the guard-test construction rule in the parent epic `airborne-wellloved-kingfisher`: owner module exempt, match the constituent conjunction or AST shape named in Approach (or the definition count where no distinctive atom exists), `# <construct>-ok: <reason>` escape marker, and behaviour pinned only by the named existing tests.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_store/paths.py` (new), `src/rebar/_store/hlc.py`, `src/rebar/_store/push_state.py`, `src/rebar/_store/sync.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/compact_trigger.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/doctor_locks.py`, `src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py`, `src/rebar/llm/overlap/queue.py`, `tests/unit/store/test_store_paths.py` (new).

## Testing
Happy path: a symlinked worktree tracker resolves every sidecar under the canonical store (real `tmp_path` symlink). Edge: a tracker whose `.git` is a gitfile (worktree) yields the common dir. Pinning: `tests/unit/test_compact_trigger.py`, `tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py`, `tests/unit/test_hlc.py`, `tests/unit/test_push_pending_marker.py`, `tests/scripts/graph/test_doctor_locks.py` pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `grep -rn "def _rebar_dir" src/rebar` returns only `src/rebar/_store/paths.py`; checked by the guard test and the grep.
- [ ] Two worktrees sharing one store via symlink produce identical `sidecar("enrich-drain.lock")` paths; checked by the new symlink test.
- [ ] All five pinning test files pass with no assertion edits; checked by `pytest` on those files and `git diff --stat`.
